narratives.Description: Implement Phase 1 of epic #2951: a single TS containedWrite API (root, target, data, mode create|replace|append) that refuses symlink escape and out-of-root targets with stable error codes; unit tests; agent/maintainer docs; optional verify:contained-writes fail-open skeleton; migrate at least one high-risk product sink onto the API; CHANGELOG cites #2951. Does not close the full epic.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent
Epic **#2951** — mandatory contained-write API + ban raw write sinks.

## Phase 1 scope
1. TS `containedWrite` API
2. Unit tests for escape and symlink-outside-root
3. Docs for agents/maintainers
4. Optional `task verify:contained-writes` skeleton (fail-open ok if documented)
5. Migrate ≥1 real high-risk sink onto the API if practical
6. CHANGELOG cites #2951

## Non-goals this phase
- Mass migration of all sinks
- Fail-closed enforcement in `task check`
- Go installer contained-write API
- Closing the full epic AC

## Acceptance
- [ ] `containedWrite` with stable error codes
- [ ] Escape + symlink-outside-root tests
- [ ] Agent/maintainer contract docs
- [ ] verify:contained-writes skeleton (fail-open documented)
- [ ] ≥1 product sink migrated
- [ ] CHANGELOG + PR cites Implements Phase 1 of #2951
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want a single contained-write primitive so new product write sinks cannot reintroduce symlink/path-escape mediums without using the API.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts (+ tests) building on assertWriteTargetSafe. 2. Document contract in docs/ + CONTRIBUTING. 3. Add verify:contained-writes skeleton with allowlist start (fail-open). 4. Migrate createNoDeftDirectiveFlag (or similar AppSec-touched sink). 5. CHANGELOG Unreleased. 6. PR Implements Phase 1 of #2951; epic comment; merge; scope:complete.

items.title: TS containedWrite API with stable error codes

narrative.Acceptance: Given root/target/data/mode, when containedWrite runs, then it writes only under root and refuses symlink escape / out-of-root with machine-readable codes.

items.title: Unit tests for path escape and symlink-outside-root

narrative.Acceptance: Given crafted targets (../ escape and symlink-to-outside-root), when tests run, then containedWrite fails closed and does not overwrite outside files.

items.title: Document contract: new sinks must use containedWrite

narrative.Acceptance: Given docs for agents/maintainers, when a new write sink is added, then the contract states it must use the API (not bespoke per-sink checks as the preferred fix).
Given task verify:contained-writes, when run, then it scans raw write sinks, reports findings, and exits 0 while fail-open (documented) until a later phase.

items.title: Migrate at least one high-risk product sink

narrative.Acceptance: Given a product write sink historically near AppSec containment, when Phase 1 lands, then it calls containedWrite instead of bare writeFileSync.
CHANGELOG Unreleased cites #2951; PR body uses Implements Phase 1 of #2951 (not Closes) unless full epic AC done.
